g.title: spa-4xt-serial

rect.data-description: the port's ACTIVE lamp, printed on the faceplate and named by Figure 54's callout list. ITS COLOURS ARE NOT STATED: Table 41 of the Cisco ASR 9000 Series SIP and SPA Hardware Installation Guide of this guide describes the STATUS LED and nothing else, and no other table in the guide covers this SPA's port lamps. The green/amber/off vocabulary here is BORROWED from the SPA family's other port lamps and is not this part's own - see provenance.leds.

circle.data-description: the SPA's STATUS lamp, the one lamp every SPA in this guide carries. Table 41 of the Cisco ASR 9000 Series SIP and SPA Hardware Installation Guide: off - SPA power is off; green on - SPA is ready and operational; amber on - SPA power is on and good, and the SPA is being configured.
